title: Server administration
mfaRequired: The admin area needs a login with a second factor. Sign out and sign in again with your second factor.
verificationText: In the test phase a login counts as verified. With “vouching” two verified people must vouch and the account must be a day old. Once the online ID is connected, only that counts.
domainsText: Whoever confirms an address with one of these domains (or a subdomain) gets the official check mark for their responsibility.
label: Label
adminsFromConfig: Who is admin is set in ADMIN_EMAILS at the hosting provider. It cannot be changed here.
demoText: One example of each kind of content: {n} example people, an offer, a wanted post, a group, an initiative, a pinboard post. Every account also gets one chat, one group, one contact request, an own offer and wanted post, a list and a note, once.
demoConfirm: Delete all example content for good? Switching it off is usually enough.
viewText: As an admin you can switch between the normal view and the admin area.
demoVisibleText: Off: nobody sees the examples any more, you neither. Nothing is deleted; switch it on again and everything is back.
